# Seal

> Open-source, agent-native e-signature. Upload, send, sign, audit — API-first. Signing is free.

- Site: https://seal.nyc
- App: https://app.seal.nyc
- Docs: https://docs.seal.nyc
- API: https://api.seal.nyc
- MCP: https://mcp.seal.nyc
- Status: https://seal.nyc/status
- OpenAPI: https://docs.seal.nyc/reference
- SDK: `npm install @vortex-api/seal`
- Repo: https://github.com/VortexNYC/seal

## Read first (agents)

1. https://docs.seal.nyc/getting-started/agents — OpenAPI contract, humans sign, bindings, handoff
2. https://docs.seal.nyc/getting-started/production — keys, webhooks, proof gates
3. https://docs.seal.nyc/mcp/tool-catalog — all 119 MCP tools (generated from code)

## Contract

OpenAPI (`apps/docs/openapi.yaml` / `/reference`) is the source of truth.
MCP (119 tools), CLI (`seal`), and `@vortex-api/seal` wrap that contract — they must not invent paths.

## Agent golden path

1. `seal login` (device flow → app.seal.nyc/device) or API key in app → Developer (`seal_…`) or MCP OAuth
2. Upload PDF → create document → add recipients → **place fields** (or use template)
3. Optional: `binding_key` + `POST /documents/apply-bindings` for deal data
4. Send → human opens `signing_url` — agents do **not** sign
5. Human handoff: `GET /documents/interaction?id=` → open `url` → poll until terminal
   - MCP: `seal_get_interaction` / `seal_wait_interaction`
   - CLI: `seal wait --document <id> --open`
6. Poll status / webhooks → viewed → signed → `document.completed` → audit + download

Subscribe webhooks to at least `document.sent`, `recipient.viewed`, `document.viewed`,
`recipient.signed`, and `document.completed` for the full signing funnel.
Verify with `verifySealWebhookSignature` from `@vortex-api/seal` (see /webhooks/verification).

When the signing URL may sit in an agent context, use graded signer auth
(`email_otp` or `access_code` on the recipient — SEA-48).

## Proof from the repo

```bash
SEAL_API_KEY=seal_… pnpm run prove:golden-path
SEAL_API_KEY=seal_… node scripts/smoke-prod.mjs
```

Checks: send (`email_sent`), public viewed/signed ceremony (privacy/consent),
webhook deliveries (viewed + signed events), completed PDF markers, audit + certificate.

Self-host without mail: `prove:golden-path --skip-invite-email` (see production doc).

## Portfolio default (SEA-59)

Seal is the **only** Vortex signing path for day-to-day company docs.
Do not open DocuSign / PandaDoc / HelloSign / Adobe Sign for Vortex work.
Gaps → SEA tickets. ADR-005.

## Self-host

```bash
git clone https://github.com/VortexNYC/seal.git && cd seal
pnpm install && pnpm exec wrangler login && pnpm selfhost
```

Cold-account checklist: https://docs.seal.nyc/getting-started/self-host

## SDK

- Node send example: `packages/sdk/examples/node-send.mjs`
- Webhook receiver sketch: `packages/sdk/examples/webhook-handler.mjs` (`verifySealWebhookSignature`)
- React embed: `packages/sdk/examples/react-embed.tsx` (`@vortex-api/seal/react`)

## Rules for agents

- Prefer API / MCP / CLI over the product UI for sender work
- Never treat a model as the signatory
- Do not invent endpoints missing from OpenAPI
- Place fields (or use templates) before send
- Vortex company signing = Seal only (no DocuSign/PandaDoc create/send)
